in_sanskrit.name: अनन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ananta is derived from the Sanskrit word अनन्त (ananta), which means 'endless', 'infinite', 'boundless', or 'endless time'. It is a significant name in Hinduism, representing the concept of the infinite and eternal. In Hindu mythology, Ananta is also the name of the serpent king who supports the cosmic ocean and is the bed of Lord Vishnu.
